plugins.title: Anchoran Code Studio
plugins.description: A local mini-IDE for building your own Anchoran plugin — file explorer, a real CodeMirror editor with autocomplete and real TypeScript support, syntax checking, Prettier formatting, "Run test on window" (runs the project in its own real window with live console output), export, and starter templates (Empty App, Counter, Task List) for New Project.
plugins.author: Fachun Corporation

recentChanges.notes: Initial release — a local mini-IDE for building your own Anchoran plugin: virtual file explorer, real CodeMirror editor with autocomplete, syntax checking and Prettier formatting, a live Preview, .zip export, "Make It Official", and "Import from Official".
Added a Console/Output panel (captures console.log/errors from a running preview) and "Open in Window" (runs the project in a real, separate Anchoran window).

New Project now offers starter templates — Empty App, Counter (React state example) and Task List (add/complete/delete, persisted to localStorage, split into logic.js + index.js) — instead of always starting from a blank file.

"Import from Official" can no longer clone Code Studio's own source. Preview can now import this repo's _shared/pluginKit.js and a curated allowlist of ~30 npm packages. Real TypeScript (.ts/.tsx) support. "Run Preview"/"Open in Window" merged into one "Run test on window" button. Console panel gains Copy. Removed "Make It Official" (Export covers it).
